export_evidence: ImportKey (India customs), slug 'livguard-energy-technologies-private-limited', counter: 'Total Shipments 7280 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 67', 'Ports 79', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28'. Rows actually seen on the free page: 4 shipment rows (plus aggregated supplier/buyer/port tables). Exact evidence line: "2026-02-28 | LIVGUARD ENERGY TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED TO THE ORDER OF LIVGUARD BRAND AUTOMOTIVE BATTERIES- (OTHER DETAILS AS PER INVOICE PACKING LIST)- ICD CONCOR DHANDARI KALAN LUDHIANA INLDH6, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 85071000 | BOL 1131040". Second row same date/destination: "LIVGUARD BRAND VRLA BATTERIES ... Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 85071000 | BOL 1131040". Third/fourth rows 2026-02-28 to Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania, HS 96081092 (pens) and 61013020 (caps) under BOL 1135801, marked 'TO THE ORDER OF FOC POP MATERIALS'. Buyer-side records also show Nepal-bound lanes via Prabhu Bank Limited (1626 shipments) and Midas Group Pvt. Ltd., Kathmandu. Top ports: DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4 (331), HONG KONG (186), ICD CONCOR DHANDARI KALAN LUDHIANA INLDH6 (154), Beirut (144).
domestic_evidence: Company website (livguard.com/about-us) footer states registered office "Plot No. 221, Phase-I, Udyog Vihar, Gurgaon 122016 Haryana, India", "CIN: U51909HR2014FTC091348", and claims "Available Across 21000+ Pincodes" plus a dealer/distributor network and SAR Group affiliation (Livpure, Livfast, Lectrix). This is a company self-declaration of domestic distribution reach, not a GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP tender award or audited annual-report revenue split. No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP contract record and no annual-report domestic/international revenue split could be retrieved: the web_search tool returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on both attempts, and tofler.in returned '404: Looks like this page decided to take a vacation.' So domestic supply is declared, not independently confirmed.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely claimed: dated customs/B-L records with HS 85071000 (lead-acid automotive batteries) moving from ICD Concor Dhandari Kalan, Ludhiana to Jebel Ali, UAE on 2026-02-28 under BOL 1131040, plus a second 2026-02-28 consignment to Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania under BOL 1135801. Declared HS 850710 matches the observed export HS 85071000 exactly, so no HS correction is needed. Caveat on the counter: ImportKey reports 7280 total shipments but the free view exposed only 4 individual rows, so the 7280 figure is a platform counter, not a verified row count; the 4 rows seen are sufficient to establish actual shipments. Note the Tanzania rows are FOC POP material (pens/caps) rather than batteries, i.e. promotional goods, while the UAE rows are the actual battery exports. Domestic side: the company is a real, active Indian entity (CIN U51909HR2014FTC091348, Gurgaon, Haryana) with a claimed 21000+ pincode dealer network, but no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report revenue split was publicly retrievable within the tool budget, so domestic_status is declared_only rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null - not public on the free views; not invented. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were examined (out of scope for this role and not grounds for rejection per project rules). Verdict: accepted; export confirmed, domestic declared only.
